scenes.headline: How the harness, not the model, sets the token bill
scenes.sub: A controlled swap: same model, new orchestration layer
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fig! A Writer team held the model fixed and changed only the orchestration around it. Here's why that moved the bill.

scenes.text: The harness builds every prompt. How much history it replays, and whether its prefix hits the cache, sets most of the bill.
scenes.mark: whether its prefix hits the cache
scenes.say: The harness builds every prompt. How much history it replays, and whether the prompt's prefix hits the cache, sets most of the bill.

steps.label: full replay: cumulative input grows as O(k²)
steps.say: Replay the whole transcript every turn, and each turn re-reads everything before it. Over a task, input grows with the square of the turns.

steps.label: compacted and cached: close to O(k)
steps.say: A harness that compacts and caches history keeps it close to linear. The gap between the two is spend that buys no quality.

scenes.title: The one price that moves
scenes.say: The biggest lever is prompt caching. The effective input price is this.

parts.note: share of input tokens read from cache: set by prefix stability
parts.say: h is the share of input served from cache, and it's set by how byte-stable the prompt prefix is.
Kappa is the cache price, about a tenth of list.

items.say: A two-zone prompt: a byte-stable prefix that's cached, and a volatile tail rebuilt each turn.
Compaction that shrinks history but keeps the front byte-identical.
Tool outputs land in a store, not the prompt.
Durable execution, so a pause or retry doesn't replay the context.
And a cap on what a failing or looping run can burn.

scenes.label: lower blended cost per task, six models held constant, quality at parity
scenes.note: 22 tasks; Writer's own harness, evaluated by Writer
scenes.say: Across six models and twenty-two tasks, cost per task fell forty-one percent at the same quality. It's Writer's own harness, evaluated by Writer.

scenes.text: The expensive input term is a cache hit only if your prompt prefix is byte-stable, and that's an engineering choice.

recap: Full replay grows input with the square of turns
A byte-stable prefix makes input a cache hit
Every model got cheaper under the same harness
scenes.say: To recap: don't replay everything, keep the prefix stable, and the savings follow any model.
